2123145393902879109.en_summary: Over the past 3 years, I've continued to see retail pile into $PEP, and continue to think that's a major mistake. Capital allocation for Pepsi has been horrific lately- And free cash flow has not covered their buybacks and dividends in years. There's a reason Wall Street sees downside despite the stock being down 15% in the last 3 years.
2123145393902879109.zh_summary: 過去 3 年，我一直看到零售投資者湧入 $PEP，並繼續認為這是一個重大錯誤。百事公司的資本配置最近很糟糕，自由現金流多年來未覆蓋其回購和股息。儘管股票在過去 3 年下跌 15%，華爾街看到下行風險是有原因的。

2123145041837527085.en_summary: Most of my commentary recently has been thematic since AI names are just indiscriminately moving up and down together now. Foci is heavily tied to CPO which hasn't reached volume yet. And they've been named to be a $TSM COUPE supplier now last month with exposure to $NVDA CPO programs. Last month, Largan cited fiber arrays as facing the greatest shortages for CPO expansion. H2 2027 from Goldman Sachs flagged accelerated CPO FAU revenue growth. But we're entering 2027 soon, so I hope we see earnings inflection with Foci similar to $SOI today with their commitments. I have a tendency to be a bit early.
2123145041837527085.zh_summary: 我最近的大部分評論都是主題性的，因為 AI 名稱現在只是不分青紅皂白地一起上下波動。Foci 與 CPO 密切相關，尚未達到量產。他們上個月被任命為 $TSM COUPE 供應商，並暴露於 $NVDA CPO 計劃。上個月，Largan 引用光纖陣列作為 CPO 擴張面臨的最大短缺。高盛 2027 年下半年標誌著加速的 CPO FAU 收入增長。但我們很快進入 2027 年，所以我希望看到 Foci 的盈利拐點類似於今天的 $SOI 及其承諾。我傾向於有點早。

ticker_notes.SOI: Hope for earnings inflection similar to Foci commitments
